terminals.name: serve
terminals.description: Local ClearNews server on http://127.0.0.1:8765 (routes: /, /api/news, /api/tts, /ws, /insights.json). The server fetches Google News RSS, cross-verifies, and distills on a background loop. Set the optional GEMINI_API_KEY env var for AI distillation; without it the server runs in deterministic heuristic mode.
